25a3(ta): gdug rtsub brdos pas brgyan pas 'jigs pa'i tshul//rmad du byung ba'i chos sgrogs gzhang ba'i tshul//shin tu gdul dka' khro bo'i snying rje'i tshul//smon lam dbang gis mi shol rngam pa'i tshul//nyon mongs bsgrubs po'i brgyur mdzad ngo mtshar
25a4(ta): tshul/khro drag dbyings nas mi g.yo zhi ba'i tshul//de la phyi tshul gar dag ni//sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs pa'i sku//rgod dang gshe' dang rngam pa gsung //ngo mtshar snying rje zhi ba thugs//dbang phyug 'dod chags te nyams can bcoms pas
25a5(ta): skegs khe lha min pa su ka ra bsad pas dpa' bor mdzad//khyab 'jug se nga ga phag gdong spu la 'dul 'jigs//gzhon nu smin drug rta rgad drag por rgod pa 'dul//tshogs bdag glang sna gshed pa'i gdul bya 'dul/sgra gcan ra hus nyi zla/
25a6(ta): khar ni mid pas rngam//klu chen saM shwa ra ces 'gro rdzogs sa g.yos ngo yang mtshar//brgya byin rang gi 'khor rnams skyong mdzad snying rje'i tshul//me lhas 'jig rten bsreg mdzad stong pas zhi//khyim bdag rin po che'i cha de med rnam bzhi ni//'khro
25a7(ta): gtum tshad med byams pas snang //gsod chen snying rje'i mtshan nyid de//sbal zhing stabs pas dga' ba'i mchog/yul bar mi 'dor btang snyoms so//glang po che rin chen stobs bcu ni//thugs rje'i stobs ni drag chen sbyin mnon//chos nyid
25b1(ta): stobs na mi dmigs nam pa'i 'gogs//mi 'byang spyod pa'i stobs ni glang po'i rdzas la rol//grub pa'i stobs ni bdud rtsi'i dngos grub rgyu//ma spangs stobs kyis brngos bcas sku la brgyan//ma g.yos stobs ni don 'thun grol ba'i brgyan//smon/
25b2(ta): lam stobs ni skal bar g.yo bar mdzad//sprul pa'i stobs na mgo stan phra men 'phro//phrag dog 'khor bar log lta cig mi ga tong //'dod chags phrag dog yum chags spyan dmar zlog/rta mchog rin chen rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi ni//
25b3(ta): chos nyid rdzu 'phrul med bzhin cir snang ba/mkhar la 'ja' tshon bzhin du rnam par 'akram/ye shes rdzu 'phrul chos kyi dbyings rtogs pa//mkha' la nyi shar 'dra ste gsal la stong //tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul bye brag ni//mkha' dang
25b4(ta): mnyam pa'i sprin phung bzhin du gsal//sprul pa'i bye brag 'phro ba'i rdzu 'phrul ni//ro gcig char 'bab snron gyi bye brag phye//de la nor bu rin chen rang bzhin ni//'gro rnams ji ltar 'dul bzhin re 'dod skong //mi zad bdag med gter chen nam

26b1(ta): yin/de nas khrag 'thung lha rnams la//'dzub bstod bya ba 'di gsung so//'gro rnams ji ltar 'dul zhing gshegs mdzad pa//shes rab rnam pa'i skal pas rgas rgung stongs//gti mug tshul gyis gti mug 'joms mdzad pa
26b2(ta): gti mug rdo rje bud+d+ha he ru ka/ye shes rdo rjes nyon mongs 'khor ba 'joms//thabs 'dzin mtshon tshe 'di skal bas dngos po 'jigs//zhe sdang tshul gyis zhe sdang 'jims mdzad pa/zhe sdang 'joms mdzad ha ru ka/rin chen
26b3(ta): dbyig ltar re ba kun skong zhing //bdag med zhi gnas chu'i skal bas 'khru//nga rgyal tshul gyis nga rgyal 'joms mdzad pa//nga rgyal rdo rangad na he ru ka/'khor ba'i 'dam du bad ltar sku 'khrungs kyang //lhag mthong ma chen skal ba
26b4(ta): thams cad sreg/'dod chags tshwal gyis 'dod chagase 'joms mdzad pa//'dod chags 'joms pad ma he ru ka/'phrin las rgya mtshos 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing //shes rab thog pa med skal pa'i rlung gis skyod//phrag dog
26b5(ta): tshul gyis phrag dog 'joms mdzad pa//phrag dog 'joms mdzad karma he ru ka/sku'i longs spyod sna tshogs mi dmigs shing //shes rab mthar phyin gti mug rnam par dag/phyag rgya gzugs kyi mchod pas mnyes mdzad ma/
26b6(ta): chos dbyings nam mkha'i dbang sbyin khro mo rgya la//thugs rje'i longs spyod sna tshogs mi dmigs shing /brtson 'grus mthar phyin zhe sdang rnam par dag/rtog pa rag bya'i mchod pas mnyes mdzad ma//sra brtan rdo rje dbang
26b7(ta): bskur khro bo rgyal//gsung gi ling spyod sna tshogs mi dmigs shing /ko tshul khrims par phyin 'dod chags rnam par dag/gsung rab sgra'i mchod pas mnyes mdzad ma//lhag mthong ye shes dbang bskur khro bo rgyal/
27a1(ta): yon tan longs spyod sna tshogs mi dmigs shing //sbyin pa mthar phyin nga rgyal rnam par dag/ting 'dzin ro mchog mchod pas mnyes mdzad cing //bdag med zhi gnas dbang bskur khro mo rgya la//'phrin las
27a2(ta): longs spyod sna tshogs mi dmigs shing //bzod pa mthar phyin phrag dog rnam par dag/tshul khrims dri'i mchod pas mnyes mdzad ma//thog med lus la dbang bskur khro mo rgyal//thugs mchog rnam dag ye shes
27a3(ta): dkar mo'i tshigs//'gugs byed mthong zung du 'brel//bden gnyis lta bas khro tshul 'gro la gzigs//dam tshig dbyings mchog bskul byed tso ru rim//gsung gis thams cad zil gnon rmongs mo'i tshogs//
27a4(ta): dbang mdzad mtha' gnyis ma gtong chu srin can//mi gnas rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing myos par lta//stong gsum dbang mdzad rgyal byang pra mo haM//thal bar byed pas thal byed ma'i tshogs//kun gyi las grub rdo rje rtsa
27a5(ta): dgu 'dzin//sa dgu'i rtogs 'joms shi ba slong bar gzigs//'jig rten thal byed sde thogs pa ta li//'byed med shes rab mi rtog spos mo'i tshogs//'khor ba'i rgyud 'dzin 'ching zhing dbang 'dren las//khro gar
27a6(ta): zags rke la rgyan gyis thugs rjes sgo la//bdade chen dbyings su 'dren mdzad puk+ka zhes/zhe sdang tshul gyis sgo la mdzad gtum mo'i tshigs//myos bad dbyings dang yi shes gnyis med las//thugs rjes klag cing ro
